ANALYTICS.NO_DATA: Nothing was recorded in this period.
ANALYTICS.TIMEZONE_NOTE: Days, weeks and months are cut in the account's reporting timezone, so everyone viewing this account sees the same totals for the same dates.

ERROR.UNEXPECTED: This report could not be loaded. Try again, and if it keeps failing contact support.

KPI.CURRENT_STATE_HINT: A reading taken now, not a count over the selected dates.

WARNING_REASON.ACTIVE_CASES_WITHOUT_A_POLICY: some open cases have no SLA policy attached, so a zero breach count does not mean nothing was late
WARNING_REASON.NO_EXECUTION_RECORD: they run inline and record nothing, so they are absent here rather than counted as zero
WARNING_REASON.TERMINAL_ROWS_PURGED_AFTER_30_DAYS: finished episodes are kept for 30 days, so earlier days are incomplete

REASON.COVERAGE_VERIFIED: rollup totals matched the source records for every day in range
REASON.FEATURE_DISABLED: rollups are turned off for this account
REASON.NO_ACCOUNT_REPORTING_TIMEZONE: no reporting timezone is set, so no rollups were written
REASON.INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: rollup totals did not match the source records, so the source records were used

CONVERSATIONS.DESCRIPTION: How much work arrived, how much was closed, how fast your team responded, and what is still open.
CONVERSATIONS.EMPTY: No conversations or messages were recorded in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

CONVERSATIONS_CREATED.LABEL: Conversations started
CONVERSATIONS_CREATED.HINT: Conversations opened in this period, however they arrived.

CONVERSATIONS_RESOLVED.LABEL: Conversations resolved
CONVERSATIONS_RESOLVED.HINT: Times a conversation was marked resolved in this period.

CONVERSATIONS_REOPENED.LABEL: Conversations reopened
CONVERSATIONS_REOPENED.HINT: Times a resolved conversation was opened again in this period.

AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.LABEL: Average first response
AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.HINT: How long a customer waited for the first human reply.

AVG_RESOLUTION_TIME.LABEL: Average resolution time
AVG_RESOLUTION_TIME.HINT: How long a conversation stayed open before it was resolved.

INBOUND_MESSAGES.LABEL: Messages received
INBOUND_MESSAGES.HINT: Customer messages. Activity notes and private notes are not counted.

OUTBOUND_MESSAGES.LABEL: Messages sent
OUTBOUND_MESSAGES.HINT: Replies sent to customers, including approved template sends. Activity notes and private notes are not counted.

UNRESOLVED_BACKLOG.LABEL: Open right now
UNRESOLVED_BACKLOG.HINT: Conversations currently open or pending. Snoozed conversations are not counted.

WHATSAPP.DESCRIPTION: Whether your WhatsApp messages are reaching people, which templates carry the volume, and what Meta is refusing.
WHATSAPP.EMPTY: No WhatsApp messages were sent in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

MESSAGES_SENT.LABEL: Messages sent
MESSAGES_SENT.HINT: Outgoing WhatsApp messages Lynomia handed to Meta in this period.

TEMPLATE_MESSAGES_SENT.LABEL: Template sends
TEMPLATE_MESSAGES_SENT.HINT: Of those, the ones sent as an approved template.

DELIVERED.LABEL: Delivered
DELIVERED.HINT: Messages Meta confirmed as delivered or read. A message delivered and later marked failed is counted only as failed.

READ.LABEL: Read
READ.HINT: Messages Meta confirmed the recipient opened.

DELIVERY_RATE.LABEL: Delivery rate
DELIVERY_RATE.HINT: Delivered as a share of what was sent.

READ_RATE.LABEL: Read rate
READ_RATE.HINT: Read as a share of what was sent.

FAILURE_RATE.LABEL: Failure rate
FAILURE_RATE.HINT: Refused as a share of what was sent.

COEXISTENCE_ECHOES.LABEL: Synced from the app
COEXISTENCE_ECHOES.HINT: Messages you sent from the WhatsApp Business app, synced into Lynomia. They are left out of every count and rate above, because their delivered status is recorded locally rather than confirmed by Meta.

CAMPAIGNS.DESCRIPTION: How the period's campaigns reached their audiences: who was addressed, who received it, and why anyone missed out.
CAMPAIGNS.EMPTY: No campaign addressed anyone in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

CAMPAIGNS_RUN.LABEL: Campaigns run
CAMPAIGNS_RUN.HINT: Campaigns that addressed at least one contact in this period.

RECIPIENTS_TARGETED.LABEL: Recipients addressed
RECIPIENTS_TARGETED.HINT: Contacts the period's campaigns selected, each counted once per campaign.

SENT.LABEL: Sent
SENT.HINT: Recipients Meta accepted a message for.

DELIVERED.LABEL: Delivered
DELIVERED.HINT: Recipients Meta confirmed as delivered or read.

READ.LABEL: Read
READ.HINT: Recipients Meta confirmed opened the message.

FAILED.LABEL: Failed
FAILED.HINT: Recipients Meta refused to deliver to.

SKIPPED.LABEL: Skipped
SKIPPED.HINT: Recipients Lynomia did not attempt, for example a contact with no phone number.

PENDING.LABEL: Still queued
PENDING.HINT: Recipients addressed but with no outcome yet.

DELIVERY_RATE.LABEL: Delivery rate
DELIVERY_RATE.HINT: Delivered as a share of the recipients addressed.

READ_RATE.LABEL: Read rate
READ_RATE.HINT: Read as a share of the recipients addressed.

FAILURE_RATE.LABEL: Failure rate
FAILURE_RATE.HINT: Refused as a share of the recipients addressed.

AUTOMATIONS.DESCRIPTION: What your delayed rules did when their moment came: how many acted, how many declined, and why.
AUTOMATIONS.EMPTY: No delayed automation reached an outcome in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

EPISODES_ARMED.LABEL: Episodes armed
EPISODES_ARMED.HINT: Times a delayed rule started its clock in this period.

SKIPPED.LABEL: Declined
SKIPPED.HINT: Episodes the rule re-checked at firing time and chose not to act on.

EXECUTION_RATE.LABEL: Action rate
EXECUTION_RATE.HINT: Acted as a share of the episodes that reached an outcome.

AWAITING_NOW.LABEL: Waiting to fire
AWAITING_NOW.HINT: Episodes whose clock is still running.

STRANDED_NOW.LABEL: Stranded
STRANDED_NOW.HINT: Episodes whose worker stopped while the actions were running. Nothing retries these on purpose, because repeating a send is worse than dropping it. A number above zero is worth investigating.

FLOWS.DESCRIPTION: How your flow runs ended: how many reached the end, how many went to a person, and how many stopped on an error.
FLOWS.EMPTY: No flow run started or ended in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

SESSIONS_STARTED.LABEL: Runs started
SESSIONS_STARTED.HINT: Flow runs that began in this period.

SESSIONS_COMPLETED.LABEL: Reached the end
SESSIONS_COMPLETED.HINT: Runs that ended at an End node in this period.

SESSIONS_FAILED.LABEL: Stopped on an error
SESSIONS_FAILED.HINT: Runs that hit an error or a safety limit and were handed to a person.

SESSIONS_CANCELLED.LABEL: Ended from outside
SESSIONS_CANCELLED.HINT: Runs ended by something other than the flow itself, such as the conversation being resolved.

HANDED_OFF.LABEL: Handed to a person
HANDED_OFF.HINT: Runs that reached a handoff node and gave the conversation to your team.

COMPLETION_RATE.LABEL: Completion rate
COMPLETION_RATE.HINT: Reached the end as a share of the runs that ended in this period.

AVERAGE_DURATION.LABEL: Average run length
AVERAGE_DURATION.HINT: Start to end, including every stretch the flow spent waiting for the customer.

AVERAGE_STEPS.LABEL: Average steps
AVERAGE_STEPS.HINT: Nodes a run passed through before it ended.

LIVE_NOW.LABEL: Running now
LIVE_NOW.HINT: Runs a customer could still answer.

COMMERCE.DESCRIPTION: What your stores reported about abandoned carts, what your team did about them, and how the order actions went.
COMMERCE.EMPTY: No store reported a cart and no order action ran in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

CARTS_SEEN.LABEL: Carts seen
CARTS_SEEN.HINT: Carts your stores first told Lynomia about in this period.

CARTS_ABANDONED.LABEL: Reported abandoned
CARTS_ABANDONED.HINT: Carts a store said were abandoned. Lynomia runs no inactivity timer of its own, so silence from a store is never counted as abandonment.

CARTS_TARGETED.LABEL: Messaged
CARTS_TARGETED.HINT: Carts where recovery outreach was accepted for sending.

CARTS_COMPLETED.LABEL: Checkout completed
CARTS_COMPLETED.HINT: Carts a store said were completed. That proves checkout completion and nothing more.

POST_TARGET_COMPLETIONS.LABEL: Completed after messaging
POST_TARGET_COMPLETIONS.HINT: Completions that happened after outreach went out. This is the order of two recorded times, not proof the message caused it: the shopper may have returned on their own, or in response to the store's own reminder.

UNTARGETED_COMPLETIONS.LABEL: Completed with no messaging
UNTARGETED_COMPLETIONS.HINT: Completions on carts Lynomia never messaged. Shown beside the figure above so the two can be compared.

TARGETING_RATE.LABEL: Messaged rate
TARGETING_RATE.HINT: Messaged as a share of the carts reported abandoned in this period.

ORDER_ACTIONS_REQUESTED.LABEL: Order actions
ORDER_ACTIONS_REQUESTED.HINT: Refunds, cancellations, status changes and resends your team asked a store to make.

ORDER_ACTIONS_FAILED.LABEL: Actions refused
ORDER_ACTIONS_FAILED.HINT: Order actions a store refused. Nothing changed in the store.

RECOVERY_MESSAGES_PREPARED.LABEL: Recovery messages prepared
RECOVERY_MESSAGES_PREPARED.HINT: Recovery messages drafted for an abandoned cart. Whether one reached the customer is a WhatsApp delivery question.

OPEN_ABANDONED_NOW.LABEL: Open abandoned carts
OPEN_ABANDONED_NOW.HINT: Carts a store called abandoned and has never called completed.

ACTIONS_UNRESOLVED_NOW.LABEL: Actions unsettled
ACTIONS_UNRESOLVED_NOW.HINT: Order actions with no final answer, including the ones where the request reached the store but the reply was lost. Those are never re-sent automatically and need checking in the store. Above zero is worth a look.

TICKETS.DESCRIPTION: How much support work arrived, how much closed, how much came back, and how often a target was missed.
TICKETS.EMPTY: No case was opened, resolved or breached in this period. Pick a wider date range to see more.

TICKETS_CREATED.LABEL: Cases opened
TICKETS_CREATED.HINT: Cases opened in this period, however they started: by an agent, from a conversation, or from an operational signal.

TICKETS_RESOLVED.LABEL: Cases resolved
TICKETS_RESOLVED.HINT: Cases whose resolution was recorded in this period. A case resolved, reopened and resolved again counts each time it was resolved in range.

TICKETS_REOPENED.LABEL: Cases reopened
TICKETS_REOPENED.HINT: Reopenings recorded in this period, counted from the case history rather than inferred from the current status, so a case reopened and resolved again is still counted.

FIRST_RESPONSE_BREACHES.LABEL: First-response targets missed
FIRST_RESPONSE_BREACHES.HINT: First-response targets recorded as missed in this period. Only cases with an SLA policy attached can appear here.

RESOLUTION_BREACHES.LABEL: Resolution targets missed
RESOLUTION_BREACHES.HINT: Resolution targets recorded as missed in this period. Only cases with an SLA policy attached can appear here.

AVERAGE_RESOLUTION_TIME.LABEL: Average time to resolve
AVERAGE_RESOLUTION_TIME.HINT: From opening to resolution, averaged over the cases resolved in this period. Absent when nothing was resolved, which is not the same as zero.

OPEN_NOW.LABEL: Open right now
OPEN_NOW.HINT: Cases in one of the four active statuses at this moment.

OVERDUE_NOW.LABEL: Overdue right now
OVERDUE_NOW.HINT: Active cases whose resolution time has already passed.
